name: Lichess
tagline: Open chess platform API for games, puzzles, tournaments, bots, and real-time board streams
description: Lichess is a free and open-source chess platform offering a comprehensive public API for accessing games, puzzles, tournaments, user data, and real-time board streams. The API supports both unauthenticated public endpoints and authenticated access for personal data and bot operations. Developers can build chess applications, bots, analytics tools, and real-time game clients using REST endpoints and Server-Sent Events (SSE) streams.

auth.details: Personal access tokens (OAuth2) via Authorization: Bearer header. Create tokens at lichess.org/account/oauth/token. Many public endpoints work without auth.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free; no paid plans. Rate limits apply (see rate_limits).

rate_limits: Not published as fixed numbers; docs warn to throttle and avoid hammering. Typical guidance: ~20-30 req/s for some endpoints; excess may return 429.
use_cases: fetch a user's recent games and ratings
stream live game moves via board API
